programs.title: The Food That Built Asia
programs.desc: Tempura, Japan's most famous fried dish is a delicate work of art. When cooked to perfection, it is unlike anything else in scent and taste.

programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: Food Safari explores the nourishing foods of Egypt as Maeve discovers the country's favorite dishes. We meet Ramy Megalaa, chef and restaurateur, who introduces Maeve to the key ingredients in Egyptian cooking and later prepares for her an aromatic fish tagine. We learn what to expect from a traditional Egyptian breakfast including the popular fava bean dish, ful medames.

programs.title: The Chocolate Queen
programs.desc: Savour the flavours of France in this indulgent episode! Kirsten bakes golden honey madeleines, a rich and comforting date pudding, and a creamy, irresistible ice cream.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Adam is joined by chef Alastair McLeod and urban gardener Connie Cao for a big ole garden harvest.

programs.desc: Scientist and community organiser, Sharon Cavanagh-Luskin travels across Far North Queensland meeting visionary food innovators to discover how tropical ingredients spark bold new ideas.
